list.yourCampaignWasSavedCreate: ↩ Your campaign was saved. Create the partner here — when you're done, a button on its edit page takes you back to the campaign with the partner already linked to the reward.
list.copiesThePageContentAs: Copies the page content as a starting point
list.buildsThePageAutomaticallyFrom: Builds the page automatically from the website, including images
list.startFromScratchAndBuild: Start from scratch and build manually
list.whichCampaignShouldThePartner: Which campaign should the partner be linked to? (optional)
list.withoutAChoiceTheDonate: Without a choice, the "Donate"/"Back to the campaign" buttons on the source website won't link anywhere until you connect them manually.
list.businessNameOptionalOtherwiseWell: Business name (optional — otherwise we'll try to detect it from the website)
list.aNewPartnerWillBe: A new partner will be created with the same page content (blocks and design) — contact details will stay empty to fill in. You can change everything later in the editor.
list.thisWillHideThePartner: This will hide the partner page permanently (the public page will return "not found"). Campaigns already linked to this partner will keep showing that the link points to a deleted partner. Only a Super Admin can undo this.
list.toConfirmTypeThePartners: To confirm, type the partner's name exactly:

errors.buildFailed: Building the page from the website failed
errors.loadForDuplicateFailed: Loading the page to duplicate failed
